name: Cassia tora seed extract
description: Cassia tora seed extract (CAS 93348-59-5 ), also referenced commercially as Senna extract, is derived from the seeds of Cassia tora and standardized for its active anthraquinone and flavonoid constituents. It functions primarily as a natural antioxidant and stabilizing ingredient across food, pharmaceutical, and agricultural formulations. In functional food and nutraceutical products, it is incorporated into dietary supplements. These supplements typically target digestive health and oxidative stress management. Pharmaceutical formulators use it as a botanical active in tablet and capsule formats where standardized anthraquinone content is required for consistent dosing. In animal feed and agricultural applications, it serves as a natural feed additive supporting gut health. It is also utilized as a component in crop protection formulations for various agricultural needs. Cosmetic and personal care manufacturers also source it for inclusion in topical products positioned around antioxidant activity. Cassia tora seed extract is supplied as a fine powder, typically in spray-dried or standardized extract form. Common commercial grades are specified by active content, including standardized anthraquinone concentrations ranging from 10% to 40%. Food-grade and pharmaceutical-grade designations are available depending on the intended application. These grades ensure compliance with regional regulatory requirements for global distribution.
